pt.headline: Nazaré oferece ondas perfeitas e vento calmo hoje!
pt.advice: As ondas de 1.4 m com período de 9 s e vento de apenas 3 kt prometem sessões longas e limpas. Não há avisos costeiros na zona, então aproveite cedo para evitar a multidão. Use fato 3/2 mm para a água a 17,5 °C.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 09:30 para pegar a melhor parte antes que o pico encha.

en.headline: Nazaré serves perfect waves with light wind today!
en.advice: Waves at 1.4 m with a 9‑second period and just 3 kt of wind promise long, clean rides. There are no coastal warnings in the area, so get there early to beat the crowd. Wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit for the 17.5 °C water.
en.crowdTip: Arrive before 09:30 to catch the best section before it gets crowded.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Boas ondas e score alto, mas há aviso costeiro ANAV NR 12/24; pode estar mais cheio.
spots.enReason: Good waves and high score, but coastal warning ANAV NR 12/24 in effect; may be crowded.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Vento mais forte (7 kt) e avisos de interação e avistamento de animais marinhos; ainda surfável.
spots.enReason: Stronger wind (7 kt) and marine animal interaction/ sighting warnings; still surfable.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes, vento leve (3 kt) e sem avisos costeiros – condições ideais.
spots.enReason: Consistent waves, light wind (3 kt) and no coastal warnings – ideal conditions.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ótimas ondas e vento leve, porém há aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Great waves and light wind, but there is a marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Condições boas, mas aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1727/26) pode exigir atenção.
spots.enReason: Good conditions, but marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26) requires attention.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Ondas ligeiramente menores e aviso de plano de salvamento marítimo (ANAV NR 2/22); ainda vale a pena.
spots.enReason: Slightly smaller waves and a maritime rescue plan warning (ANAV NR 2/22); still worth a try.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas fracas, vento forte (8 kt) e múltiplos avisos de interação com animais marinhos; melhor escolher outro spot.
spots.enReason: Weak waves, strong wind (8 kt) and multiple marine animal interaction warnings; better to pick another spot.
